# Third-party code

- `clipper.js` is [clipper-lib](https://www.npmjs.com/package/clipper-lib) 6.4.2, unmodified: Timo's JavaScript
  port of Angus Johnson's Clipper polygon library. Snowflake uses it to merge shapes and to inset them one
  line width at a time. Boost Software License 1.0, in `LICENSE_1_0.txt`.
